summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.80/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.80 a gallon across Wisconsin as of August 8, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 10¢ lower than a week ago, 32¢ higher than a month ago, and 97¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.60) and the highest in Superior ($4.03).
